title: A core has no row of its own to tick in Deactivate parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, with a Core Charge above $0, so it has a core described Core for followed by part A's description.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Type Core for followed by part A's description in the Search box.
  4. Replace the search text with part A's part number.
  5. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • No row is listed for the core: it has no row of its own, so there is nothing to tick for it.

Step 4:

  • Exactly one row is listed, part A's own, with its core charge in the Core column.

Step 5:

  • Bulk mode ends and nothing has changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-E3: “A core has no row of its own on the Inventory list, in Export or on the Part Library list, so it cannot be ticked for a bulk change. Its name (S13-R15) and its history are recorded on the core's own Part History page, which has no link on screen in this release. The core reason in S10-R13a applies when a core reaches a status change by any other route.”
  • Key Decisions: “A core follows its part. A core is never activated, deactivated, tracked or untracked on its own.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “A core always has the same active state and the same tracking state as the part it belongs to.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
